title: Speaking to camera — knowledge sharing, experts, brand stories, customer testimonials
summary: One person speaking to camera. The A-roll is cut into jump cuts on the pauses (silences and fillers removed), framings alternate wide and tight so every cut reads as intentional, B-roll and graphics illustrate what is said, word-by-word captions carry it with the sound off.
signals: one face in a fixed frame most of the time
speech in the camera's own audio

runtime.why: Talking content holds longer than demos only while every sentence earns its place: cut pauses, fillers and repeats first.

hook.purpose: the boldest sentence of the talk, said in the first breath; a pattern-break frame or B-roll under it

structure.purpose: why it matters to the viewer, one sentence
the points, one per beat; B-roll or a graphic on every point
structure.graphics: step or checklist, stat, chart, image, highlight

structure.purpose: follow, comment, save, or the offer

music.mood: low, unobtrusive bed or none; never a vocal track under speech

compliance: Numbers on screen (stat, chart) have a source the speaker can name; label estimates
Medical, financial, legal advice: hedged, no guaranteed outcomes; expert credentials real
A testimonial is from a real customer who agreed to it; staged scenes never labelled as a real review
No other person's footage or audio without a licence

testimonial.about: A customer's own story: the result first, the problem, the experience, the outcome. Honesty is the format.

structure.purpose: what was wrong before, in their words
what they did, B-roll of the product in use
the outcome in their words; no exaggeration added in text

agency.about: A service pitch (agency, studio, clinic, school) told to camera: loud text blocks that mirror the speech, the brand mark landing on its name, portfolio cards on an animated grid between the talking shots, a closing card. The loudest of the talking-head styles: every spoken thought is also a text block, so captions run only where no block says it.

runtime.why: A service pitch has more to prove than a tip (who, what, for whom, plans, offer): it holds while a new picture or text block arrives every 1-2 s.

hook.purpose: the place or the pain, shouted: a city name or 'đừng bỏ qua' ("don't miss it") with a megaphone, then the problem as a red block

structure.purpose: the pain in one red block
the brand named: its mark lands on the word, the promise as a block
portfolio and process on cards over the animated grid, kinds of work or sector as tags, one proof graphic (RAW/FINAL, counter)
support and experience, said to camera
the plans, the range, who it suits
one action: inbox; the free consultation and the limited offer as pills; a closing card with the mark

music.mood: bright, driving corporate pop: a kick on every card change, a lift into the offer; never a vocal

compliance: Figures said in the voice (customers served, videos per month, delivery days) are the brand's own and can be shown with evidence: say who must keep it
Customer names, logos and work shown on cards: written consent from each customer, or the footage is the agency's own
RAW / FINAL cards use the same take; no staged 'before' made worse on purpose
Limited-time offers ("chỉ có trong tháng này", "only this month") are real and dated; commercial-content disclosure on
Music is CC0, self-made or licensed for this account; the TikTok Commercial Music Library for business accounts
